_doc: Manual corrections applied on top of the importer's automatic choices (deep merge; a value of null deletes a key).
Use it when the heuristics get something wrong: a gun pointing backwards (rotY + 3.1416), a legend that should use a
different character, a held prop that should stay visible, a clip mapping, a model size.
Paths are relative to public/assets. Run `node tools/assets/import.mjs` again after editing.
